# PerfAtlas

> The modern directory for Apache JMeter plugins — search, discover, compare, and track the velocity and GitHub health of load testing extensions, with free browser-based JMeter tools and tutorials. Synced daily from the official JMeter Plugins registry.

PerfAtlas (https://plugins.jmeter.ai) indexes **150 Apache JMeter plugins**, **4 curated plugin stacks**, and **36 technical guides**. Maintained by NaveenKumar Namachivayam (QAInsights). Last generated: 2026-11-26.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints for AI Agents

- [Full LLM Context](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/llms-full.txt): Complete catalog of all 150 plugins, collections, tools, and guides in a single file.
- [All Plugins JSON API](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/api/plugins.json): Full structured dataset of all 150 plugins.
- [Trending Plugins JSON API](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/api/trending.json): Top 25 plugins ranked by weekly download delta.
- [Plugin Markdown Endpoint](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/{plugin-id}.md): Clean markdown summary, CLI install command, compatibility, and FAQs for any plugin (e.g., https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jpgc-perfmon.md).
- [Blog Post Markdown Endpoint](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/blog/{slug}.md): Raw markdown for any tutorial.
- [Blog RSS Feed](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/rss.xml): Latest tutorials and guides.
- [XML Sitemap](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/sitemap-index.xml): Full site index with lastmod dates.

## Core Pages & Free Tools

- [Plugin Directory](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/): Search, filter by category, track trends, and build install lists. Supports query search via `/?q=<term>`.
- [Compare Plugins](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/compare/): Side-by-side comparison table (`?ids=jpgc-perfmon,jpgc-casutg`).
- [JMeter Tools Hub](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/tools/): Free browser-based utilities for load testing.
- [JMeter CLI Command Builder](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/tools/cli-builder/): Visual builder for `jmeter` and `PluginsManagerCMD` commands.
- [JMeter Thread Calculator](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/tools/thread-calculator/): Calculate required threads from target RPS, response time, think time, and headroom.
- [Recently Updated Plugins](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/recently-updated/): Active plugins sorted by latest GitHub commit.
- [Potentially Abandoned Plugins](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/potentially-abandoned/): Stale or archived JMeter plugins to watch out for.
- [Vendors](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/vendor/): Browse plugins by author or organization.
- [Collections](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/): Curated stacks for CI/CD, Observability, Load Shaping, and AI workflows.
- [Blog](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/blog/): 36 in-depth JMeter plugin guides and benchmarks.

## Curated Collections

- [CI/CD Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ci-cd-stack/): Headless-friendly plugins for failing fast in pipelines.
- [Observability Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/observability-stack/): Stream live metrics to your existing dashboards during tests.
- [Load Shaping Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/load-shaping-stack/): Precise ramp profiles, target RPS, and safe failure thresholds.
- [AI-Ready Starter](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ai-ready-starter/): All AI-augmented plugins in one install.

## Top 10 Most Downloaded Plugins (as of 2026-11-26)

1. [jmeter - Core](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-core/) (`jmeter-core`) — 39,092 downloads. Core functionality for JMeter, including GUI and engine.
2. [jmeter - HTTP Protocol Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-http/) (`jmeter-http`) — 39,088 downloads. This sampler lets you send an HTTP/HTTPS request to a web server.
3. [jmeter - Various Core Components](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-components/) (`jmeter-components`) — 39,086 downloads. Ships a lot of various components for JMeter, including Debug Sampler
4. [Plugins Manager](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jpgc-plugins-manager/) (`jpgc-plugins-manager`) — 39,085 downloads. Adds menu item into Options menu to access UI for installing/removing additional plugins
5. [jmeter - Java Components](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-java/) (`jmeter-java`) — 39,068 downloads. Java Sampler and other components
6. [jmeter - TCP Protocol Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-tcp/) (`jmeter-tcp`) — 39,057 downloads. The TCP Sampler opens a TCP/IP connection to the specified server. It then sends the text, and waits for a response.
7. [jmeter - OS Process Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-native/) (`jmeter-native`) — 39,042 downloads. The OS Process Sampler is a sampler that can be used to execute commands on the local machine.
8. [jmeter - JDBC Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-jdbc/) (`jmeter-jdbc`) — 39,033 downloads. This sampler lets you send an JDBC Request (an SQL query) to a database.
9. [jmeter - FTP Protocol Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-ftp/) (`jmeter-ftp`) — 39,006 downloads. This controller lets you send an FTP 'retrieve file' or 'upload file' request to an FTP server.
10. [jmeter - JMS Support](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/jmeter-jms/) (`jmeter-jms`) — 39,005 downloads. Offers JMS Subscriber, Publisher and JMS P2P
